messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing big increase in activity or talking more than normal"
set: ["call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing big increase in activity or talking more than normal", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing trouble sleeping", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing suicidal thoughts or dying", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing attempts to harm self", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing feeling agitated, restless, angry, or irritable", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing any other unusual change in behavior or mood", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing new or worse depression, anxiety, or panic attacks", "call healthcare provider or 911 if noticing acting aggressive or violent or acting on dangerous impulses", "call healthcare provider if more sensitive to pain", "do not take more medicine without talking to healthcare provider", "call your healthcare provider if this happens", "call healthcare provider if symptoms are severe", "call healthcare provider if pain gets worse", "call healthcare provider if have new pain", "if light blinks red, call healthcare provider", "if device falls off, call healthcare provider"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
